Services.dc.html.title: 10 · Services catalogue — define, then price per branch × company

Branch.dc.html.title: 09 · Branch page — full view, services & prices, time slots

review.text:
SERVICES + BRANCHES — REVIEW

Problems in the previous version
1. One job, three screens: to make a branch bookable you visited Branches, Services and Slots, with no signal of what was still missing.
2. The same link was editable in two places (service ↔ slot from both sides) — easy to get out of sync.
3. The service drawer did five jobs (define, group content, branch prices, company prices, slots) and was ~1,900px tall.
4. Company prices were nested inside each branch block, so you could not compare prices across branches or companies.
5. Nothing warned that a switched-on item with no slot cannot be booked.

What changed
• Mental model: Catalogue = WHAT (define + price). Branch = WHERE and WHEN (offer + schedule).
• New Branch page (09) replaces the separate slots screen: tabs Services & prices / Time slots / Details / Team, in the order you set a branch up.
• Slots are edited only on the branch page. Everywhere else shows a status badge that links there.
• Prices are a matrix: branch rows × (general price + one column per company). Empty company cell = follows general.
• 'No slot' warning on branch cards, the branch hero, each offer row and the catalogue.
• Service drawer cut to two steps: 1 Define, 2 Branches & prices.
• Branch cards show readiness (offers, slots, gaps) and one primary action: Open branch.

n10.text:
09 BRANCH PAGE — new (replaces the slots screen)

• Full view (first tab, default): branch details, the services it offers with general and company prices, and the weekly slots with what is offered in each — one read-only page. Each section has Edit that jumps to its tab; a slot card opens that slot in the editor; Print / PDF.
• Hero doubles as the setup tracker: 1 offers → 2 slots → items with no slot. The tiles switch tabs.
• Services & prices tab: one row per catalogue item. Switch = offered here. General price + a column per company, total incl. 15% VAT under each. Slot badge per row ('in 2 of 3' / 'no slot') jumps to the slots tab. Unsaved-changes bar with Save / Discard.
• Time slots tab: week list + editor. A slot = days + from–to + the items offered in it. Only items switched on for this branch can be ticked.
• Details tab holds the branch data, vaccines and tags; Team tab lists members.
• Clickable: switch an item on, type prices, change tab, edit a slot, switch branch.

Sample: Chest X-ray at Test2 is on with no slot, to show the warning. Its price (35) is illustrative.

Open: slot capacity / appointment length; who may add company columns.

n9.text:
10 SERVICES CATALOGUE — after the review: the drawer is now 2 steps (1 Define, 2 Branches & prices as a branch × company matrix). Slots are no longer edited here; each branch row shows a slot badge linking to the branch page. Points below about slots / nested company prices describe the earlier version.

• One catalogue for services AND service groups, in the sidebar.
• Scope is a first-class column: 'General for Mwafq' (all companies) or 'Custom for company' (one company, its own price and content).
• Add drawer, 2 choices first: What (Service / Service group) → For whom (General / Custom). Custom reveals the company picker; Group reveals the services checklist. Clickable here.
• Assigned per branch, priced per branch: the drawer has one row per branch (switch on + base price; VAT 15% and total calculated per row). The table lists each branch with its own price, or 'not offered'.
• Priced per company too: in a General item every branch row has a general price plus optional company-specific prices (company + price); companies without one get the branch's general price. In a Custom item the branch price is that company's price.
• Time slots: each switched-on branch lists that branch's slots (defined in screen 10) with a tick for each slot this item is offered in. Summary shows per branch in the table. Save requires at least one slot per branch.
• Update: every row has Edit, which opens the same drawer prefilled (clickable; Save updates the table). Editable: names, services in a group, branches, prices, company prices, active/stopped. Locked: type and scope. Warning that price changes apply to new bookings only.

Sample scope values are illustrative. Individual service prices are unknown, so they show '—'.

Open questions: does a General item need Mwafq approval before companies see it? Can a provider create a brand-new service, or only pick from Mwafq's master list?

n8.text:
08 BRANCHES — mapped to ServiceProviderBranch

• Edit: every card has Edit, which opens the same drawer prefilled for that branch (clickable; the card being edited gets a violet border). 'Full view' opens the branch page.
• Own sidebar section; before, branches were one line in the profile.
• Card = Translations (Name, Address), Classification, Country + City, Contact, Logo, Status, plus links to the child collections: Services, Vaccines, Slots, Tags, Team.
• Status (bool) is a switch: 'receives bookings'.
• Delete follows HandleDeleteAsync: blocked when the branch has users or reservations, so the card says why and offers the status switch instead.
• Add branch drawer has exactly the constructor fields: logo, name + address per language, classification, country, city, latitude / longitude (filled from the map pin), contact, status, tags. Services, vaccines and slots come after save.
• Bracketed values are placeholders (not visible in the current screenshots).

Assumptions to confirm: Contact = full name, email, phone. The number under the branch name (65412) is shown as-is; the entity has no code field.

title.text: Mwafq Service Provider Portal — Phase 16 UX redesign

readme.text:
HOW TO READ THIS CANVAS

Row 1 = daily operations (Today, Reservations in 3 views). Row 2 = money, people, setup.

THEME: Pulse (pulse-theme.md). Arabic-first RTL, warm neutrals, one violet accent, one dark hero per page, Tajawal / Noto Kufi Arabic / Geist. All tokens live in project/pulse.css; components reference tokens only. Each artboard has a Dark toggle in its Tweaks.

Shell change: the big provider header card that repeated on every tab (~180px) is gone. Provider identity + branch switcher and the 5 modules move into the Pulse sidebar (hero palette); the top bar keeps page title, global search (Ctrl K), Check-in (scan QR), language, theme and account.

Saved views and KPI tiles now live inside each page's hero as selectable tiles.

Reservations is the core workflow, so it gets 3 views of the SAME data and filters: Table (default, bulk work), Board (active pipeline only), Calendar (capacity per day/branch).

Details / QR / attachments / status change are merged into ONE preview drawer, so staff never lose their place in the list.

The Reservations artboard is clickable: try the saved-view tabs, row checkboxes (bulk bar) and clicking a name (drawer).

Sample data is taken from the current screenshots; 3 upcoming bookings (Lina, Sara, Omar) were added.

STATUS MODEL (yours): Accepted is the default. Accepted → Check-in → In progress → Complete. Side exits: Delayed, No show, Cancelled. There is no accept/decline step anywhere.

n1.text:
01 TODAY — what changed

• Old Overview = a static profile form. Staff opened it every day and got nothing actionable.
• New landing page answers: who arrives today, what is waiting for me, what is overdue.
• Needs-attention list with direct actions (delayed bookings, unpaid claims, missing closing day).
• KPI tiles are links to pre-filtered reservation views.
• Next step inline (Check in / Start exam) — no modal.
• Profile details moved to Profile (07).

Backend: counts endpoint for tiles (or reuse list API with filters + totalCount).

n2.text:
02 RESERVATIONS — what changed

• Saved views with live counts replace the generic Filter popup for 90% of cases.
• Status + Fitness merged into clear pills; Cost + Tax collapsed into one amount (base + VAT on hover line).
• Row number (#NO) and the expand icon removed; real reservation ID shown instead.
• One contextual primary action per row: the next valid step (Check in → Start exam → Record result).
• 'Create Package Request' modal with a single Status dropdown → replaced by that one-click next step (wrong title, 3 clicks → 1). Invalid status jumps are no longer possible.
• Details modal + QR screen + Edit attachments → one drawer with sticky footer actions.
• Bulk bar: check in, export selected.

n3.text:
03 BOARD — challenge

A full Kanban of all statuses is a poor fit: 'Completed' grows forever and buries the active work.

Board shows only the ACTIVE pipeline (Accepted → Check-in → In progress, plus Delayed). Complete / No show / Cancelled are one collapsed column with counts and a link to the table.

Drag is limited to valid transitions; moving to Completed opens the fitness-result dialog (result is mandatory).

Details: every card has a Details button that opens the same booking panel beside the board (clickable here); the selected card gets a violet border.

n4.text:
04 CALENDAR

• Saudi work week (Sun → Thu, Fri/Sat shaded).
• Colour + label per status (never colour alone).
• Branch filter on the left; today column highlighted.
• Accepted = outlined, Check-in / In progress = filled violet, Complete = green, Cancelled = dashed and muted.

Backend (recommendation): branch daily capacity / slots to show load per day.

n5.text:
05 LEDGERS — what changed

• Summary first: outstanding SAR, aging buckets (3 of 4 unpaid claims are 90+ days).
• FROM / TO dates → one 'Period' (Sep 2026).
• Free-text note 'Monthly claim for branch 139, Riyadh Branch' parsed into a Branch column.
• Total + Total with tax → one amount with VAT line.
• Missing invoice is an action (Upload), not grey text.
• Data issue spotted: claim 323 says 'branch 183, Riyadh' but 183 is Amman elsewhere.

n6.text:
06 TEAM — what changed

• Users → 'Team' (they are provider staff, not patients).
• Add member opens a drawer, not a full-screen modal; the list stays visible.
• Form grouped: Account & access (required) vs Personal details (optional, collapsed).
• Challenge: Address, Country, City, Nationality are required today for a receptionist account. Recommend optional (BE validation change).
• Role explained inline; branches as multi-select chips.

n7.text:
07 PROFILE — issues fixed

• 'Company Size: Biolab' and 'Category: 28' show raw/wrong values → labelled fields + names.
• CR and VAT both '592002' → validation flag (VAT in KSA is 15 digits).
• Bank account shown in full → masked IBAN with reveal (permission-gated).
• Closing Day '------' → explicit 'Not set' warning + action.
• Profile completeness so missing data is visible.
